ready_drafts.title: An ant guarding the jaggery
ready_drafts.literal_meaning: An ant as the guard of the jaggery store.
ready_drafts.explanation: The supposed guard has an appetite for exactly what it must protect. The dictionary uses this mismatch for entrusting something to its would-be consumer: the arrangement itself puts the goods at risk. In conversation, the image can make a questionable appointment look absurd before anyone has to explain it at length. It questions a particular conflict between duty and temptation, rather than declaring that a whole kind of person is dishonest.
ready_drafts.meaning_odia: ଯାହାକୁ ଜଗିବାକୁ ଦିଆଗଲା, ଜଗୁଆଳିର ଲୋଭ ସେହି ଜିନିଷ ଉପରେ—ଚିତ୍ରଟିର ମଜା ଏଇଠି। ଅଭିଧାନ ଖାଦ୍ୟକୁ ତାହାର ଖାଦକ ଜିମାରେ ଦେବାର ଅସଙ୍ଗତି ବୁଝାଇଛି। କୌଣସି ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ ଦେବା ବେଳେ ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ ଓ ନିଜର ଲୋଭ ମୁହାଁମୁହିଁ ହେଉଥିଲେ, ଏହି ଛୋଟ ଚିତ୍ର ବଡ଼ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ବିନା କଥାଟି ଧରାଇଦିଏ। ପ୍ରଶ୍ନଟି ସେହି ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥାକୁ ନେଇ, କୌଣସି ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀକୁ ଜନ୍ମରୁ ଅସାଧୁ କହିବାକୁ ନୁହେଁ।
ready_drafts.english_summary: A guard tempted to consume the very thing entrusted to them.
ready_drafts.odia_summary: ଯାହାକୁ ରକ୍ଷା କରିବା କଥା, ଜଗୁଆଳିର ଲୋଭ ସେଇଠି।
ready_drafts.usage_example: A club puts its snack box in the charge of the member who keeps finishing the biscuits before meetings. Another member laughs, “ଗୁଡ଼ଘରେ ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି ଜଗୁଆଳି!” They agree to keep the box available only when everyone arrives. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
ready_drafts.cultural_context: The source explicitly explains entrusting food to its consumer. Modern organizational use is editorial extension, not documented origin. Parenthetical ପରିଛା is an alternative guard term in the source, not a new saying.

ready_drafts.title: The ant grows wings
ready_drafts.explanation: The image sounds like a new freedom, but the dictionary turns it into a sign of approaching ruin or death. That reversal gives the expression its ominous force: what looks like an advance is read as a warning. A speaker may use it when another person becomes recklessly confident, though that particular application is an editorial example rather than a separate source gloss. The image carries an old belief; it is not a biological account of winged ants or a prediction that someone must come to harm.
ready_drafts.meaning_odia: ଡେଣା ଲାଗିବା ଶୁଣିଲେ ନୂଆ ସ୍ୱାଧୀନତାର ଚିତ୍ର ଆସେ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଅଭିଧାନ ଏହାକୁ ସର୍ବନାଶ ବା ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ପୂର୍ବର ସମୟ ଭାବେ ବୁଝାଇଛି। ଯାହା ଉନ୍ନତି ପରି ଦିଶୁଛି, ସେହି କଥାକୁ ବିପଦର ସଙ୍କେତ କରିଦେବାରେ ଉକ୍ତିଟିର ତୀବ୍ରତା। କେହି ବେପରୁଆ ଆତ୍ମବିଶ୍ୱାସ ଦେଖାଇଲେ ଏପରି କହିବାର ଏକ କଳ୍ପିତ ପ୍ରୟୋଗ ହୋଇପାରେ; ଅଭିଧାନ କିନ୍ତୁ ସେହି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ଦେଇନାହିଁ। ଏଠି ପୁରୁଣା ବିଶ୍ୱାସର ଛବି ଅଛି, ଡେଣାଥିବା ପିମ୍ପୁଡ଼ିର ଜୀବନ ବିଷୟରେ ବୈଜ୍ଞାନିକ ଦାବି ନୁହେଁ।
ready_drafts.english_summary: An apparent gain becomes an ominous image of approaching ruin in the source’s gloss.
ready_drafts.odia_summary: ଲାଭ ପରି ଦିଶୁଥିବା ଡେଣାକୁ ସ୍ରୋତର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ ଆସନ୍ନ ବିପଦର ଛବି କରାଯାଇଛି।
ready_drafts.usage_example: After one successful event, an organizer announces a much larger one without checking the costs. A friend remarks, “ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ିର ପକ୍ଷୀ ଲାଗିବା!” The organizer asks for the actual budget concerns rather than taking the remark as a prediction. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
ready_drafts.cultural_context: Explicit source gloss is approaching ruin/death. Preserve its severe warning register; do not soften it into a simple celebration of growth or teach the surrounding obsolete zoology as fact. Digital ପକ୍ଷୀ retained exactly; printed note2 visually checked without silent modern replacement by ଡେଣା.

ready_drafts.odia: ହାତୀ ଗଳି ଯାଉଛି ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି ଗଳିବାକୁ ବାଟ ନାହିଁ
ready_drafts.title: An elephant passes, an ant is stopped
ready_drafts.literal_meaning: An elephant passes through, but there is no way for an ant.
ready_drafts.explanation: The impossible difference in scale makes the complaint funny: a passage admits an elephant but somehow cannot admit an ant. The dictionary explains this as overlooking large matters while keeping watch over small ones. The target is misplaced scrutiny, not careful attention itself. In an argument, the image can turn the question back on the person enforcing a tiny rule: what larger thing have they allowed to pass?
ready_drafts.meaning_odia: ହାତୀ ଗଳିଯାଉଛି, ଅଥଚ ପିମ୍ପୁଡ଼ି ପାଇଁ ବାଟ ନାହିଁ—ଆକାରର ଏହି ଅସମ୍ଭବ ଫରକରେ ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ। ଅଭିଧାନ ବଡ଼ ବଡ଼ କଥାରେ ଦୃଷ୍ଟି ନରଖି ଛୋଟ ଛୋଟ ବିଷୟକୁ ଜଗିବା କଥା କହିଛି। ଖୁଟିନାଟି ଦେଖିବା ନିଜେ ଭୁଲ ନୁହେଁ; ବଡ଼ ତ୍ରୁଟି ଛାଡ଼ି କେବଳ ଛୋଟ କଥାରେ ଅଟକିବାକୁ ଏହା ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରେ। କେହି ସାମାନ୍ୟ ନିୟମ ଧରି ବସିଲେ, ଏହି ଚିତ୍ର ତାଙ୍କୁ ବଡ଼ ଅବହେଳାଟି ଦେଖାଇପାରେ।
ready_drafts.english_summary: Large lapses pass unnoticed while tiny matters face strict scrutiny.
ready_drafts.odia_summary: ବଡ଼ ଅବହେଳା ଛାଡ଼ି ଛୋଟ କଥାକୁ କଠୋର ଭାବେ ଜଗିବା।
ready_drafts.usage_example: A committee approves a large unexplained expense, then spends half an hour disputing a tiny stationery claim. A member says, “ହାତୀ ଗଳି ଯାଉଛି ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି ଗଳିବାକୁ ବାଟ ନାହିଁ,” and asks to examine the larger bill first. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
ready_drafts.cultural_context: Printed4856 note3 resolves digital ବାୟ as ବାଟ. The source explains unequal attention to large/small matters, not a particular legal system or caste. Both alternative forms belong to one analogy.

ready_drafts.title: An ant climbing the lampstand
ready_drafts.literal_meaning: Being an ant and climbing onto the lampstand.
ready_drafts.explanation: The dictionary applies this small creature and high perch to a “small” person intervening in “big” matters. The wording does more than describe scale: it can dismiss someone’s right to take part by placing them below the subject under discussion. That ranking belongs to the source’s social judgment, not a fact about anyone’s worth or ability. Read critically, the analogy lets us hear how a vivid image can keep a person out of a conversation instead of answering what they said.
ready_drafts.meaning_odia: ଛୋଟ ପିମ୍ପୁଡ଼ି ଓ ଉଚ୍ଚ ଦୀପରୁଖାର ଛବିକୁ ଅଭିଧାନ ‘ଛୋଟ ଲୋକ’ ହୋଇ ‘ବଡ଼ କଥା’ରେ ହସ୍ତକ୍ଷେପ କରିବା ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ିଛି। ଏହା କେବଳ ଆକାରର ତୁଳନା ନୁହେଁ; କାହାକୁ ତୁଚ୍ଛ କରି ତାଙ୍କ କଥା କହିବାର ଅଧିକାରକୁ ଅସ୍ୱୀକାର କରିବାର ସ୍ୱର ମଧ୍ୟ ଏଥିରେ ଅଛି। ସେହି ଉଚ୍ଚନୀଚ ବିଚାର ସ୍ରୋତର ପ୍ରୟୋଗର ଅଂଶ, କାହାର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ବା ସାମର୍ଥ୍ୟର ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ। ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରି ପଢ଼ିଲେ ଦେଖାଯାଏ, ଉତ୍ତର ଦେବା ବଦଳରେ ଏକ ଚିତ୍ର କିପରି ଲୋକଟିକୁ ଆଲୋଚନାରୁ ବାହାରେ ରଖିପାରେ।
ready_drafts.english_summary: A historical analogy can dismiss a supposedly insignificant person’s participation in larger matters.
ready_drafts.odia_summary: କାହାକୁ ତୁଚ୍ଛ ଭାବି ବଡ଼ କଥାରେ ତାଙ୍କ ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣକୁ ଖାରଜ କରିବାର ଏକ ପୁରୁଣା ଉପମା।
ready_drafts.usage_example: At a residents’ meeting, a newcomer questions an expense. Someone dismisses the question with “ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି ହୋଇ ଦୀପରୁଖାରେ ଚଢ଼ିବା.” Another resident replies that the question should be answered, whoever asked it. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
ready_drafts.cultural_context: An unnumbered analogy follows note3 and precedes5 in both witnesses; labelled fourth position for this audit only. Source’s ଛୋଟ ଲୋକ is not evidence of a named caste, innate inferiority or lack of ability. Critical reading preserves the dismissive register, not an endorsed lesson to stay in one’s place.

ready_drafts.english_title: An elephant’s mouthful, an ant’s hundred years
ready_drafts.literal_meaning: If a mouthful falls from an elephant’s mouth, an ant has food for a hundred years.
ready_drafts.explanation: The joke makes the same scrap almost nothing to one creature and an enormous provision to another. The dictionary extends the contrast to an elephant-like person leaving a small amount that can sustain many ant-like lives. The hundred years is the saying’s extravagant measure of scale, not a feeding calculation. The comparison can make an overlooked remainder suddenly look substantial.
ready_drafts.meaning_odia: ହାତୀ ପାଇଁ କଳେ ମାତ୍ର ଖାଦ୍ୟ, ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି ପାଇଁ ଶହେ ବରଷର ଖୋରାକ—ଏହି ମାପର ତଫାତରେ କଥାଟିର ମଜା। ଅଭିଧାନର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ ହାତୀ ପରି ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ଅଳ୍ପ କିଛି ଛାଡ଼ିଗଲେ ସେଥିରେ ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି ପରି ଅନେକ ଜୀବ ପୋଷିହେବାର କଥା ଅଛି। ଶହେ ବରଷ ଏଠାରେ ଅତିଶୟୋକ୍ତି। ଜଣକ ପାଇଁ ତୁଚ୍ଛ ଅବଶିଷ୍ଟ ଅନ୍ୟ ଜଣକ ପାଇଁ କେତେ ବଡ଼ ହୋଇପାରେ, ଚିତ୍ରଟି ସେହି ତଫାତ ଦେଖାଏ।
ready_drafts.english_summary: A tiny remainder to one can be a large provision to another.
ready_drafts.odia_summary: ଜଣକର କଳେ ଅବଶିଷ୍ଟ ଅନ୍ୟ ଜଣକର ବହୁତ ଖୋରାକ।
ready_drafts.example: A large printing shop offers its unused paper offcuts to a small drawing club. Seeing how many sketchbooks they can make, a member quotes the elephant-and-ant analogy. (Original imagined use.)
ready_drafts.context: The dictionary explicitly interprets unequal scale through elephant-like and ant-like figures. This records a comparison, not a claim that people have unequal worth or a historical account of patronage.
ready_drafts.narrative_credit: Explanation adapted and expanded from ପିମ୍ପୁଡ଼ି — Odia Wiktionary.

ready_drafts.english_title: An elephant urinates; ants must swim
ready_drafts.literal_meaning: When an elephant urinates, the ants swim.
ready_drafts.explanation: The blunt bodily image makes scale impossible to miss: an ordinary discharge for the elephant becomes a flood for the ants. The dictionary’s gloss goes further than the heading’s swimming and says the smaller creatures drown. The contrast can picture how a large actor’s small action overwhelms those with much less room to absorb it; that application is editorial, rather than a separate use supplied by the dictionary.
ready_drafts.meaning_odia: ହାତୀ ମୁତିଦେବା ପରି ସାଧାରଣ କାମ ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି ପାଇଁ ପହଁରିବାର ପରିସ୍ଥିତି କରିଦିଏ। ବଡ଼ ଓ ସାନର ମାପକୁ ଏହି ଖୋଲା ଦେହଜ ଚିତ୍ର ତୀବ୍ର କରେ। ଅଭିଧାନର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି ବୁଡ଼ିଯିବା କଥା ଅଛି। ବଡ଼ ପକ୍ଷର ଅଳ୍ପ କାମର ପ୍ରଭାବ ସାନ ପକ୍ଷ ପାଇଁ କେତେ ଭାରି ହୋଇପାରେ—ଏପରି ପ୍ରୟୋଗ ଚିତ୍ରଟିର ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠ; ଉତ୍ସରେ ଅଲଗା ସାମାଜିକ ପ୍ରୟୋଗ ଦିଆଯାଇନାହିଁ।
ready_drafts.english_summary: An ordinary act at one scale can overwhelm life at another.
ready_drafts.odia_summary: ବଡ଼ ଜୀବର ସାଧାରଣ କାମ ସାନ ଜୀବ ପାଇଁ ବିପଦ।
ready_drafts.example: A large buyer delays payment by a few days, calling it a minor adjustment. A small supplier struggling to pay workers replies with the elephant-and-ant analogy. (Original imagined use, not a collected application.)
ready_drafts.context: Preserve the coarse bodily image and the difference between heading and gloss. This is a recorded analogy, not modern zoological evidence. The business example is newly composed.
ready_drafts.narrative_credit: Explanation adapted and expanded from ପିମ୍ପୁଡ଼ି — Odia Wiktionary.

ready_drafts.english_title: Ants eating through the jaggery store
ready_drafts.literal_meaning: The analogy of ants eating up the jaggery store.
ready_drafts.explanation: The sweet store is something the ants will keep returning to. The dictionary applies the image to work that must always be guarded carefully against an enemy. Its emphasis is continuing exposure, rather than a single finished loss. Unlike putting an ant in charge of the store, this analogy does not appoint the eater as guardian.
ready_drafts.meaning_odia: ଗୁଡ଼ଘରକୁ ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ିର ଆସିବା ଥରେ ଜଗିଦେଲେ ଶେଷ ହୋଇଯିବା ପରି ନୁହେଁ। ଅଭିଧାନ ଏହି ଚିତ୍ରକୁ ଶତ୍ରୁଠାରୁ ସର୍ବଦା ସାବଧାନତା ସହ ରକ୍ଷା କରିବାକୁ ଥିବା କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ସହ ଯୋଡ଼େ। ଏଠାରେ ଜୋର ଲଗାତାର ସତର୍କତା ଉପରେ। ଗୁଡ଼ଘରେ ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ିକୁ ଜଗୁଆଳି କରିବାର ଅନ୍ୟ ନ୍ୟାୟଠାରୁ ଏହା ଅଲଗା; ଏଠାରେ ଖାଦକକୁ ରକ୍ଷାର ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ ଦେବା କଥା ନାହିଁ।
ready_drafts.english_summary: The source applies the sweet-store image to work needing continuing protection.
ready_drafts.odia_summary: ଶତ୍ରୁଠାରୁ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକୁ ସବୁବେଳେ ସାବଧାନରେ ରକ୍ଷା କରିବାର ଚିତ୍ର।
ready_drafts.example: A club restores its noticeboard after repeated deliberate damage. When someone says one repair has settled the matter, another member uses the jaggery-store analogy to explain why they still need to watch it. (Original imagined use.)
ready_drafts.context: The source says enemy, not merely accident or ordinary wear. The new example therefore retains deliberate interference. Note1 in this same source is the different guardian/conflict-of-interest analogy; keep the two separate.
ready_drafts.narrative_credit: Explanation adapted and expanded from ପିମ୍ପୁଡ଼ି — Odia Wiktionary.

ready_drafts.english_title: A stream of people like a line of ants
ready_drafts.literal_meaning: The analogy of an ant-line forming.
ready_drafts.explanation: This is a visual comparison rather than a rebuke. The dictionary describes a place where many people gather and compares their movement to a line of ants. The eye follows the continuing file of people. The source does not turn the image into a lesson about obedience, hard work or unquestioning conformity.
ready_drafts.meaning_odia: ଅନେକ ଲୋକ ଏକାଠି ହୋଇ ଧାର ବାନ୍ଧି ଚାଲୁଥିବା ଦୃଶ୍ୟକୁ ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି ଧାର ସହ ତୁଳନା କରାଯାଏ। ଅଭିଧାନର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଏହି ଦୃଶ୍ୟଗତ ସାମ୍ୟକୁ ଧରେ। ଆଖି ଆଗରେ ଲୋକଙ୍କ ଚାଲିବାର ଧାରଟି ଲମ୍ବିଯାଏ। ଏଠାରେ ପରିଶ୍ରମ କିମ୍ବା ଶୃଙ୍ଖଳାର ଉପଦେଶ ଯୋଡ଼ିବା ଦରକାର ନାହିଁ।
ready_drafts.english_summary: A moving crowd is pictured as a line of ants.
ready_drafts.odia_summary: ଲୋକଙ୍କ ଚଳନ୍ତି ଧାର ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି ଧାର ପରି ଦିଶେ।
ready_drafts.example: Looking down from a terrace as people file towards a fair, someone remarks, “ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି ଧାର ଲାଗିବା ନ୍ୟାୟ।” (Original imagined use.)
ready_drafts.context: The headword is preserved in the saved digital witness. The gloss contains the different spelling ପୁମ୍ପୂଡ଼ି; that discrepancy remains in the exact capture rather than being silently repaired. Genre is descriptive analogy.
ready_drafts.narrative_credit: Explanation adapted and expanded from ପିମ୍ପୁଡ଼ି — Odia Wiktionary.

ready_drafts.literal_meaning: The analogy of ants being mad for jaggery.
ready_drafts.explanation: The ants’ pull towards sweetness supplies a picture of someone’s marked eagerness or greed. The dictionary allows both interest and greed, so the comparison need not carry the same accusation on every occasion. A playful comment about enthusiasm can turn sharp when the attraction is self-serving. The object of desire need not be food.
ready_drafts.meaning_odia: ଗୁଡ଼ ପ୍ରତି ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ିର ଆକର୍ଷଣକୁ ଧରି ଜଣକର ବିଶେଷ ଆଗ୍ରହ କିମ୍ବା ଲୋଭ ବୁଝାଯାଏ। ଅଭିଧାନ ଦୁଇଟି ଅର୍ଥର ସୁଯୋଗ ରଖିଛି। ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରତିଥର ଏହାକୁ କଠୋର ଲୋଭର ଅଭିଯୋଗ କରିଦେଲେ କଥାର ସ୍ୱର ବଦଳିଯିବ। ଅବସର ଅନୁସାରେ ଏହା ଆଗ୍ରହକୁ ନେଇ ହାଲୁକା ଥଟ୍ଟା ହୋଇପାରେ, କିମ୍ବା ଲାଭ ପାଇଁ ବ୍ୟାକୁଳତାକୁ ବିନ୍ଧିପାରେ।
ready_drafts.english_summary: An attraction can be playful eagerness or pointedly described greed.
ready_drafts.odia_summary: ବିଶେଷ ଆଗ୍ରହ ବା ଲୋଭକୁ ଗୁଡ଼ ପ୍ରତି ପିମ୍ପୂଡ଼ିର ଆକର୍ଷଣ ସହ ତୁଳନା।
ready_drafts.example: A friend who never misses a book sale is already at the door before it opens. A companion laughs and uses the ants-and-jaggery analogy. (Original imagined use, choosing the source’s interest rather than greed sense.)
ready_drafts.context: The dictionary explicitly supplies interest or greed as applications. The new example chooses interest; no origin story, popularity measurement or universal claim about ant behaviour is added.
ready_drafts.narrative_credit: Explanation adapted and expanded from ପିମ୍ପୁଡ଼ି — Odia Wiktionary.
